title: Privacy indicators for camera, microphone and screen capture are easy to miss: no app name without hovering, no way to show them outside the System Tray
line: When an app starts sharing your screen, a notification now names the app and has an End button.
explanation: When an app started a screencast through the portal, the only sign was a red tray icon, which can be hidden in the tray's overflow or off-screen, and named the app only in its tooltip. The portal also turns on Do Not Disturb for the duration of the sharing, so nothing else drew attention to it. Following Nate's direction (a server-side notification like Spectacle's), the portal now sends a 'Screen Sharing Started' notification naming the app, with an End button that stops the sharing; it closes itself when the sharing ends. It uses critical urgency so it still pops up through the screen-sharing Do Not Disturb.

commits.message:
screencast: show a notification when screen sharing starts

The only sign that an app had started sharing the screen was a tray
icon, which is easy to miss and names the app only in its tooltip. Now
a notification names the app when sharing starts and offers to end it.

BUG: 525038

media.caption: Dolphin (test client) has just started sharing the screen: only the small red dot in the tray, no app name
Same with the change: a 'Screen Sharing Started — Sharing contents to Dolphin' notification with an End button pops up

reviews.text: While using a server-side notification follows the maintainer's general direction, this patch closes bug 525038 with BUG: despite only covering screen sharing and leaving camera and microphone indicators unaddressed. In addition, setting Urgency=Critical in xdg-desktop-portal-kde.notifyrc to bypass the portal's own screen-sharing Do Not Disturb causes Plasma to ignore CloseOnTimeout, leaving a critical-styled popup permanently stuck on screen (and visible inside the shared video stream) until manually dismissed.
changes: Implement capture-start notifications for camera (cameraindicator) and microphone (plasma-pa) in addition to screen sharing so the full scope of bug 525038 is resolved before closing it with BUG: 525038.

Do not use Urgency=Critical for Event/screencaststarted; use Normal/High urgency with a working auto-timeout and avoid suppression by the portal's own screen-sharing DND inhibition without bypassing manual user Do Not Disturb or leaving a permanent popup over the shared screen.
Ensure the notification is also closed if the ScreenCastSession is destroyed without emitting closed (e.g. connect to QObject::destroyed as well).

reviews.text: The screen-sharing part follows Nate's c2 direction (a server-side notification when capture starts), sits in the right place (xdg-desktop-portal-kde, next to the existing remotedesktopstarted notification), and the End action and close-on-session-end wiring are sound. The screenshot shows it working through the portal's own Do Not Disturb. But the bug is explicitly about camera, microphone and screen capture, and Nate's 'notification for these' covers all three, while this commit uses BUG: 525038 and covers only the portal screencast, as its own notes admit. So it doesn't close the bug. Critical urgency also makes the popup sticky and shows it inside the shared stream, which works against the DND inhibition the portal turns on just before. A maintainer may ask for that to be justified or reworked.
changes: Cover camera (cameraindicator) and microphone (plasma-pa) capture start with the same kind of notification naming the app, in their own repos, or change this commit to CCBUG: 525038 and land it as part of a set that closes the bug.

Justify or rework the Critical urgency: e.g. send the notification before the NotificationInhibition is created, or give it a normal timeout, so it doesn't stay on screen inside the shared stream for the whole session.
